sql: WITH t AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, upper(market_ticker) AS mkt, upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS ev, pnl::numeric/quantity*100 AS c FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) ), k AS ( SELECT series, mkt, ev, c, CASE WHEN series IN ('KXFEDMENTION','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION') THEN mkt WHEN ev='' THEN mkt ELSE series||':'||ev END AS g FROM t ), within AS ( SELECT series, g, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, sum(c) AS s FROM k WHERE series IN ('KXNFLSPREAD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWTI','KXMLBHR','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXINXU') GROUP BY 1,2 ), wagg AS ( SELECT series, count(*) AS contests, max(mkts) AS max_mkts, round(avg(mkts),2) AS avg_mkts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mkts>1) AS multi_contests, round(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE mkts>1 AND s<0)/100,2) AS loss_multi, round(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE mkts=1 AND s<0)/100,2) AS loss_single FROM within GROUP BY 1 ), xs AS ( -- cross-series: how many OTHER mmsell series traded the same event token SELECT a.series, a.ev, count(DISTINCT b.series) AS n_series FROM (SELECT DISTINCT series, ev FROM k WHERE series IN ('KXNFLSPREAD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWTI','KXMLBHR','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXINXU') AND ev<>'') a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT series, ev FROM k WHERE ev<>'') b ON b.ev = a.ev GROUP BY 1,2 ), xagg AS ( SELECT series, round(avg(n_series),2) AS avg_series_per_event, max(n_series) AS max_series_per_event, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_series>1) AS shared_events, count(*) AS events FROM xs GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT w.series||'|'||w.contests||'|'||w.max_mkts||'|'||w.avg_mkts||'|'||w.multi_contests ||'|'||coalesce(w.loss_multi::text,'0')||'|'||coalesce(w.loss_single::text,'0') ||'|'||coalesce(x.avg_series_per_event::text,'1')||'|'||coalesce(x.max_series_per_event::text,'1') ||'|'||coalesce(x.shared_events::text,'0')||'|'||coalesce(x.events::text,'0') AS row FROM wagg w LEFT JOIN xagg x ON x.series=w.series ORDER BY w.series
